### Maker rebates

| Tier | 14d weighted maker volume | Maker fee |
| ---- | ------------------------- | --------- |
| 1    | >0.5%                     | -0.001%   |
| 2    | >1.5%                     | -0.002%   |
| 3    | >3.0%                     | -0.003%   |

On most other protocols, the team or insiders are the main beneficiaries of fees.
